# KeyboardLayoutManager

> **File:** `services/system/KeyboardLayoutManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Active xkb layout of the main keyboard, shared by every KeyboardLayout widget. Read once (CompositorManager.withKeyboard), then again whenever Hyprland reports a layout switch or a config reload (no polling).

### Properties

- `layouts` (var)
- `layoutIndex` (int)
- `keymapName` (string)

### Functions

- `refresh()`
- `cycle(direction)`: "next" or "prev", on every keyboard
